events.verdict: Mathurin (IND) cleanly deflects the ball away from Claxton (BKN).
Johnson (BKN) brushes Turner's (IND) arm as he secures the ball and the contact is marginal.
Claxton (BKN) pulls Turner's (IND) jersey away from his body and affects his FOM off-ball.
Claxton (BKN) is already in Nembhard's (IND) path and he absorbs the contact that occurs during the pick.
Turner (IND) legally contests Johnson's (BKN) jump shot, making "high-five" contact after the ball is released.
Johnson (BKN) cleanly dislodges the ball from Turner (IND).
Siakam (IND) does not advance the ball into the frontcourt within eight seconds.

Johnson (BKN) grazes the top of Siakam's (IND) head as he contests the shot near the rim, and the contact is marginal.  Contact to an opponent's head/face can be deemed marginal when the result of a natural basketball move, provided the contact is not disproportionate or uncontrolled.
Johnson (BKN) pins the ball to his side and resumes his dribble.
Haliburton (IND) swipes his hand down and initiates contact with Watford's (BKN) arm after he has gathered the ball, and the contact affects his driving shot attempt.
Watford (BKN) brushes Haliburton's (IND) arm as he is passing the ball and the contact is marginal.
Johnson (BKN) brings his hand towards Siakam's (IND) front and the contact at the start of the drive is marginal.
Nembhard (IND) moves alongside Johnson's (BKN) path with his arms in a vertical position and he absorbs the contact from Johnson as he cuts back towards the basket.
Nembhard (IND) and Johnson (BKN) come together at the same spot and the contact on the perimeter is marginal.
Siakam (IND) steps into Johnson's (BKN) space and initiates body to body contact as he is elevating for the shot attempt.
Haliburton (IND) legally contests Watford's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
Martin (BKN) wraps Siakam (IND) off ball and affects his FOM during the inbound.

Martin (BKN) wraps his left arm around Mathurin's (IND) side, which affects Mathurin's FOM during the inbound play. The illegal contact occurs prior to Nembhard (IND) releasing the inbound pass and an away from the play foul is correctly assessed on this play.
Mathurin (IND) and Martin (BKN) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Martin (BKN) commits a take foul on Mathurin (IND).
Siakam (IND) legally contests Johnson's (BKN) jump shot attempt.
